arguments.query: WITH t AS (SELECT order_id, sum(quantity*unit_price_cents) c FROM order_items GROUP BY 1) SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(t.c), sum(p.amount_twd) FROM orders o JOIN t ON t.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id AND p.payment_status='ok' GROUP BY 1

WITH t AS (SELECT order_id, sum(quantity*unit_price_cents)/100.0 c FROM order_items GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT order_id, sum(refund_amount_twd) rf FROM refunds GROUP BY 1) SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(t.c), sum(coalesce(r.rf,0)) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN t ON t.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_id=o.order_id WHERE c.region_code='SG' AND o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1
